title: OMIR Common Definitions (R1)
description: Shared sub-schemas for OMIR R1 resources. Referenced via $ref by every resource schema. OMIR — Open Memory Interoperability Resources.

Id.description: Resource-local identifier, unique within its resourceType inside a Bundle.

Reference.description: FHIR-style typed reference of the form 'ResourceType/id'.

Instant.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp. UTC is RECOMMENDED.

UnitInterval.description: A normalized score in the closed interval [0,1].

Meta.description: Metadata envelope. MAY appear on any OMIR resource.

profile.description: Canonical URLs of profiles this resource claims to conform to.

source.description: Implementation that produced the resource, e.g. 'veld/0.7.6'.

maturity.description: OMIR Maturity Model (OMM) level of this resource TYPE in the spec, 0 (draft) .. 5 (normative/stable).

Extension.description: Typed, namespaced extension. Carries implementation-specific data (e.g. Veld's 20-signal scores, external isotropy/closure dimensions) WITHOUT breaking core conformance. Consumers MAY ignore unknown extensions.

url.description: Canonical URL that defines this extension.

valueJson.description: Arbitrary JSON value for structured extensions.

Confidence.description: Calibrated confidence. Bayesian Beta(alpha, beta) posterior plus a derived point estimate.

Decay.description: Forgetting state. Anchored resources resist decay. Mirrors OMIR's 'better forgetting' principle.

Provenance.description: Where a resource came from and how much to trust the origin.

sourceType.description: Origin class, e.g. conversation | document | webhook | observation | command.
